limitations: The desktop graph is a named operable region with semantic grouping and named controls; the explicit ARIA tree remains the hierarchy-navigation authority. ARCH-02 does not claim that the graph itself implements the ARIA tree pattern.
Projection summaries report the currently visible hierarchy after filtering, not the immutable full-catalog inventory when a filter is active.

The dependency-free witness source-binds the production stack and hierarchy-accessibility consumers. It does not infer computed roles, accessible names, keyboard focus, or Axe results from source text; the focused unit and browser gates own those behaviors.

The browser gate uses Playwright-managed Chromium and Axe only on the graph and tree states it exercises. It does not claim other browser engines, operating-system screen-reader parity, physical-device input, or complete accessibility conformance.

Installed-package and production-build evidence proves the committed checkout and local frozen installation, not future package support, registry availability, vulnerability status, or dependency freshness.

WEB-01 remains authority for exact hierarchy inventory and layout, WEB-07 for the complete responsive tree keyboard model, WEB-08 for broad accessibility acceptance, and WEB-09 for visual fidelity and neutral branding.
